def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    paths = [
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2002.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2003.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2004.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2005.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2006.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2007.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2008.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2009.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2010.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2011.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2014.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2015.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2016.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2017.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2018.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2019.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2020.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2021.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2022.csv",
        "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2023.csv",
    ]

    matched = []
    for p in paths:
        ms = glob.glob(p)
        if not ms:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No match for path: {p}")
        matched.extend(ms)

    dfs = []
    for p in sorted(set(matched)):
        year = int(p.split("water-body-testing-")[-1].split(".csv")[0])
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df["sourceYear"] = year
        df["sourceFile"] = p.split("/")[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    return pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

def process(loadAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadAllYears.copy()

    # Focus on marine beaches only
    df = df[df["Beach Type Description"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "marine"].copy()

    # Normalize violation flag; treat null/unknown as non-violation per prompt's safety-by-absence framing
    v = df["Violation"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df["isViolation"] = v.isin(["yes", "y", "true", "t", "1"])

    # A beach is "always safe" if it never has any violation in any sampled record (2002-2023)
    by_beach = df.groupby("Beach Name", dropna=False)["isViolation"].any().reset_index(name="everViolation")
    always_safe = by_beach[~by_beach["everViolation"]].copy()

    return pd.DataFrame({"alwaysSafeMarineBeaches": [int(always_safe.shape[0])]})

operators.customDisplayName: Filter concatenated 2002–2023 dataset to Beach Type Description='Marine' (case-insensitive); normalize Violation to boolean isViolation (yes/y/true/1 => True; otherwise False including nulls); group by Beach Name and compute everViolation=any(isViolation); count marine beaches with everViolation=False and return single-row DataFrame with column alwaysSafeMarineBeaches.
